objections.about: The customer says this is their own food blog, but the reply treats it as a generic site block and never mentions that the owner can check and change the site's no-pin setting (the nopin meta tag, often controlled by a blog plugin or SEO settings), which is the likely cause and the real fix.

The suggested workaround of appending ?ref=pin&v=111 to the link is an unverified guess presented as a fix with a promised result; it will not clear a site-level no-pin setting, and the v=111 parameter is unexplained.
